title: Jelena, first run, 0.3.125
who: Jelena, 41, office worker from Novi Sad, 170 cm and 74 kg, wants to lose a few kilos slowly, does pilates twice a week, cooks Balkan and Italian food, reads Serbian on an Android phone and is not technical.
goal: Set up the app on Saturday 7 November, then at a café log her own croque madame, keep Ana's meatballs and Marko's chocolate cake without counting them, add the menu and send Ana her numbers. On Monday 9 November find Saturday's lunch and the friends' plates again and plan a dinner to cook.
result: Jelena finished setup (goal 1) in 24 taps and 3 typed fields, about 6 minutes, and logged her own lunch in 5 taps (643 kcal, 42 g protein). Goal 2 took two tries and about 30 taps over roughly 12 minutes: her first try at Ana's plate ended with the plate thrown away by 'Nije moje', and she found the way to keep a friend's plate (pencil, 'Istraživanje', 'Tuđi') by luck. From there Marko's plate, the menu (goal 3, 5 taps) and sending Ana's numbers (goal 4, 2 taps) went well, though the menu changed Ana's numbers from 603 to 528 kcal after she had sent them. On Monday she found Saturday's lunch in 2 taps and the friends' plates under Recepti, Posluženo (goal 5), and planned dinner for today and tomorrow in 2 and 4 taps (goal 6), but cooking steps need the AI and planning sarma overwrote Marko's saved plate. The biggest problems: no 'someone else's plate' answer where the app asks, a friend's plate that stays on the Tanjir and corrupts later work, and a lot of English on Serbian screens. Test notes: the app was reopened between scripts, which interrupted setup once; I restarted fresh once to count taps on a clean path; the test phone does not carry the photo store between scripts, so the lunch photo on Monday was checked in one unbroken session (it is kept).
build: 0.3.125, the local build without accounts; the AI is a stand-in for plate and menu photos, absent elsewhere

findings: Blocker
Planning dinner overwrote Marko's saved plate

Monday evening she planned Sarma and tapped 'Napravi ga na Tanjiru'. The app said 'Tvoj tanjir već ima 1 namirnicu: Chocolate cake.' (Marko's cake, still on the Tanjir since Saturday). She tapped 'Počni nov tanjir'. The new plate kept the card 'Posluženo, Sačuvano u Receptima, pod Posluženo' with 'NAZIV: Marko: čokoladna torta', and the line 'Istražujem sliku. 6 namirnica pročitano ... Nije upisano: nije tvoj obrok.' In Recepti, 'Marko: čokoladna torta' now shows 'oko 409 kcal · 22 g proteina' and the foods 'Cabbage, raw 150 g, Beef mince, 15 % fat, raw 90 g ...' under his cake photo. On reopening, Tanjir asked 'Tvoj tanjir od subota, 12:40: Sarma, sa tvoje slike. Da li si to pojela?'. She cannot get Marko's cake numbers back.

When a plate is saved under Posluženo, take it off the Tanjir, or cut the link the moment the Tanjir gets other food. 'Počni nov tanjir' must start a plate with no photo, no Posluženo card and no 'Istraživanje' label.
Friction
The second plate at the table can only be a dessert or a snack of hers

One minute after logging her lunch she photographed Ana's meatballs. The app asked 'Meatballs in tomato sauce, 1 minut posle obroka (Croque madame with salad). Dezert uz obrok (ručak) ili posebna užina?' with two buttons, 'Dezert uz obrok (ručak)' and 'Posebna užina'. Both mean she ate it. She picked 'Posebna užina' because 'računa se zasebno' sounded closest to 'not with mine'. The question also vanished when the app was reopened, and the plate became 'Večera, 20:00'.
Add a third answer on this question: 'Tuđi tanjir (ne računa se)', which saves it under Posluženo as someone else's. Do not call a main dish a dessert: ask 'Još jedno tvoje jelo, ili tuđi tanjir?'.
Friction
'Nije moje' throws the plate away and says nothing

On Ana's read plate she tapped the link 'Nije moje' (20 px high, next to 'Pojedeno', 'Pola pojedeno', 'Dodaj namirnicu'). The plate went back to 'Tanjir je još prazan.' with no message. 'Recepti' said 'Ovde još nema ničega.' She wanted to keep the plate and expected 'Nije moje' to do that. She had to photograph Ana's plate again.
Make 'Nije moje' save the plate under Posluženo as 'Tuđi' and say so ('Sačuvano kao tuđi tanjir, u Receptima pod Posluženo'). Offer 'Nemoj da čuvaš' separately. Make it a button of 44 px.
Friction
Keeping a friend's plate is hidden behind a pencil and the word 'Istraživanje'

The only way she found: tap the unlabeled pencil beside 'Užina · van plana', then under 'Za šta je?' choose 'Istraživanje', then 'Gotovo'. Only then the card 'Posluženo' with 'ČIJI JE TANJIR: Moje / Tuđi', 'Tuđi tanjir' and 'Podeli brojeve' appears. She found it by luck on the second try. 'Istraživanje' does not say 'someone else's plate' to her. After choosing it, 'ČIJI JE TANJIR' still had 'Moje' selected. A photo picked from 'Tvoje fotografije' does get the question 'Čiji je ovo tanjir, i kada?' with 'Pojedeno u 12:13 / Jedem sada / Istraživanje'. A photo taken with the shutter does not.

Ask 'Čiji je ovo tanjir?' after every plate photo, with 'Moj, jedem sada' and 'Tuđi tanjir'. Rename 'Istraživanje' to something like 'Samo gledam / tuđi tanjir'. When she picks it, preselect 'Tuđi' or ask.
Confusing
The menu photo silently changed numbers she had already sent

Before the menu Ana's plate was '603 kcal, 32 g proteina' and she sent that card. After the menu photo the visit list showed 'oko 528 kcal · 28 g proteina'. Marko's went from 'oko 456 kcal · 6 g' to 'oko 494 kcal · 7 g' after she picked 'Čokoladna torta, 130 g'. The list gives no reason. Only the plate's own page says 'Jelovnik je dao težinu. Količine sada prate jelovnik, a ne procenu sa fotografije.' The share card still says 'pročitano sa fotografije'. The Tanjir tab kept showing Marko's cake at '~120 g'.

After a menu match show one line on the visit: 'Jelovnik je promenio: Ana 603 → 528 kcal'. Offer the menu photo before 'Podeli brojeve' ('Imaš jelovnik? Slikaj ga pre slanja'). Put 'težina sa jelovnika' on the share card.
Confusing
The menu did nothing for her own lunch, and her lunch is not part of the visit

She hoped the menu would help all three dishes. The menu page read 'Krok madam, salata, 280 g' but linked only Ana and Marko. Her lunch stayed at 643 kcal from the photo estimate of 327 g. The visit is titled 'Posluženo · 1 poseta, 2 tanjira' and lists only 'OSTALI ZA STOLOM'. Nothing says that her own plate is elsewhere (on Danas).
Show her logged meal from the same hour in the visit ('Tvoj tanjir: Croque madame, 643 kcal, upisano') and let the menu match it too, with a question before changing a logged meal.
Confusing
Friend plates left on the Tanjir are treated as hers

With Ana's and Marko's plates on screen the app kept coaching her: 'Tvoj tanjir je 2,5 ispod cilja. Dodaj jednu od ovih iz svojih namirnica da ga podigneš', 'Tvoj tanjir je 6,4 ispod cilja', 'Uklopi u moj obrok (obrok)', '✕ Nutritivno. Više od pola energije ovog obroka (obrok) je mast: 53 posto, 35 g.' Marko's cake stayed on the Tanjir for two days.
For a plate marked 'Tuđi' hide goal coaching and 'Uklopi'. Show only numbers, name, share, and 'Sledeći tanjir'. Clear the Tanjir once the plate is saved.
Friction
Friends' plates are kept under 'Recepti', below a line that says nothing is there

On Monday she found Ana's and Marko's plates only because she remembered 'Sačuvano u Receptima, pod Posluženo'. The Recepti tab opens with 'Dodaj recept' and 'Ovde još nema ničega. Dodaj jedan gore, ili napravi prvi na Tanjiru.' and a big 'Napravi moj prvi recept'. The plates are one screen further down. Saturday's day view in Plan and the 'Ranije' card on Danas do not mention the visit.
Link the visit from that day ('Subota: ručak + 2 tanjira za stolom ›'). In Recepti show Posluženo first when there are no recipes, and drop 'Ovde još nema ničega' when the tab has content.
Confusing
The read plate screen is long and its numbers disagree

After reading her plate the screen ran about four phone heights. 'Pojedeno' sat about 2.5 screens down, after 'Koraci' (recipe steps she does not need at a café). The largest button was 'Uklopi u moj cilj'. Energy appeared three ways: '643 kcal', 'Oko 520 do 850 kcal i 42 g proteina', 'Ručak: oko 517 kcal od tvojih 1.550'. The text 'Ostavi kako jeste uzima tanjir kakav jeste' names a button that is not on the screen. The strip 'F | c | fi- | p' and lines like 'f- C+ fi- p-' are codes with no key. The breakfast question says 'Jela sam ga / Preskočila sam' and then explains 'Pojela sam: ...'.

For a photo taken now, put photo, name, kcal, protein and 'Pojedeno / Tuđi tanjir' on the first screen. Show one energy figure and say once what the range is. Remove or explain the letter codes. Move 'Koraci' and 'Uklopi' below.
Confusing
'Zapiši šta si jela' opens 'Šta ti se jede?', and labels change between screens

From Danas she tapped 'Zapiši šta si jela' and landed on 'Šta ti se jede? Dodaj svoje namirnice. Chef Mealan određuje količine.' The only photo entry is 'Slika mog obroka', which she also had to use for Ana's plate. Next to it 'Skeniraj' opens the same camera in another mode. The plate line read 'Ručak, 13:45 po satu · Van plana · Regularan obrok · Mešavina'. After logging, Danas said 'Po planu' and 'Pojedeno po planu: Ručak.'
Open the camera or a 'Šta si jela?' title from 'Zapiši šta si jela'. Rename the button 'Slikaj tanjir'. Use one word for the same state (Van plana or Po planu).
Confusing
Plan and Danas show different numbers under the same words

On Saturday after lunch Danas said '643 od 1.550 kcal danas'. The Plan tab for the same day said '0 od 1.550 kcal danas', '3 slobodna termina', 'Ručak, 13:45: Izaberi obrok'. Plan counts what is planned, Danas what is eaten, but both use 'od 1.550 kcal danas'. On Monday the Plan said 'od 1.550 kcal, utorak' for Tuesday, a pilates day that setup gave '1.600' kcal.
Label Plan numbers 'planirano' and Danas numbers 'pojedeno'. Show the eaten lunch in its Plan slot. Use the training-day target on training days.
Confusing
Setup tells her she does not train, and shows things she was never asked

She entered pilates on Tuesday and Thursday. The protein text then said 'Tvoj raspon je 90 do 120 g dnevno ... jer još ne treniraš redovno.' Her pilates is renamed 'Mobilnost, lako'. Pilates is not in the examples under 'Lako' ('joga, mobilnost, istezanje, lagana vožnja bicikla'). The summary 'Ti' card lists body, job and steps but not training. 'Tvoj pregled' states 'Posao, fiksno radno vreme, 09:00 do 17:00' and 'Obroci 3 dnevno, 07:30, 13:45 i 20:00', which she never entered. A warning says 'Svakog dana tvoji ugljeni hidrati su ispod 45 % energije, donje granice EFSA opsega.' with nothing to do about it. 'Trener može kasnije da podesi ove brojeve.' and 'Tvoj trener vidi da si nešto označio' appear though she has no trainer. 'PD' is the first of her five numbers and is explained as 'broj koji razlikuje hranu od marketinške tvrdnje'. She wanted to lose weight slowly. 'Gubitak masti' offers only 'oko 20 % manje'.

Say 'jer treniraš lako, bez treninga snage' when days are set. Add pilates to the 'Lako' examples and keep her word. Ask or mark the assumed work and meal times as 'pretpostavka, promeni'. Drop trainer lines when there is no trainer. Explain PD with an example plate. Offer a slower pace.
Friction
Tapping a goal shows no result on screen

She tapped 'Gubitak masti'. The card got a tick. The numbers appeared below 'Održavanje', 'Izgradnja mišića' and 'Performanse', out of view. The hint 'Izaberi šta želiš, i pojaviće se tvoji brojevi.' was itself at the bottom. She scrolled by habit.
Scroll to the numbers after a goal is chosen, or collapse the other goal cards.
Confusing
'Slažem se' swaps the form for a health question

She tapped 'Slažem se' under 'Pre tvojih brojeva' expecting the grey body form below to become active. The form disappeared and 'Da li nešto od ovoga važi za tebe?' took its place, with 'Dalje: 1. Ti' at the bottom. The step numbers then changed (the goal step was '1.' before, '2.' after).
Number the health question as its own step and say 'još jedno pitanje pre tvojih podataka'. Keep step numbers fixed.
Friction
After an interrupted setup, 'Uključeno' is not 'dom'

She left the app in step 5 and came back. Danas showed 'Za podešavanje: gde kupuješ'. That opened 'Gde kupujem i kuvam' in Ja, where each place has a link 'Neka bude dom' (19 px high) and a pill 'Isključeno'. She tapped the pill for 'Serbia, elsewhere': 'Uključeno', toast 'Dodate osnovne namirnice: 17.' She finished the page and 'Tvoj pregled'. Danas still said 'Za podešavanje: gde kupuješ' until she went back and tapped 'Neka bude dom'. In the uninterrupted setup one chip does it. On this page the other places are in Serbian ('Minhen, Nemačka, Austrija') while the chips are English.
On the Ja page ask one thing first: 'Gde živiš?' with the same chips as in setup. Show the on/off pills for extra places only after a home exists.
Language
Dish names and whole lists in English on Serbian screens

Plate titles: 'Croque madame with salad', 'Meatballs in tomato sauce', 'Chocolate cake', while the foods under them are Serbian ('Ćufte', 'Pire krompir'). These names go to Danas, Plan and the saved plates. Dinner list: 'Skyr bowl with berries', 'Oats, skyr and banana', 'Omelette with bread', 'Chicken, rice and greens', 'Tuna salad wrap', 'Protein pancakes', 'Cottage cheese and fruit', with marks 'fits', 'close', '2,4 under' (the Plan later says 'uklapa se'). Sarma's foods: 'Cabbage, raw', 'Beef mince, 15 % fat, raw', 'Rice, white, raw', 'Onion, raw', 'Tomato passata', 'Olive oil'. Quick list: 'Greek yogurt 2%', 'Quark, low fat (Magerquark)', 'Cottage cheese (Hüttenkäse)', 'Eggs', 'Salmon, cooked', 'Rice, cooked', 'Oats', with 'typical values, check your pack' and 'estimate · often'. 'Chicken breast, cooked' in one list and 'Pileća prsa, pečena' in another. Grouping question: 'Main: cabbage, beef mince, onion, tomato passata, olive oil · Side: rice'. Cuisine texts: 'Grilled meat and peppers, fresh white cheese and sour cream ...', 'Šopska salad with grilled chicken', 'Ćevapi with ajvar and onion'.

Use the Serbian dish name the reader returns. Translate the basic dishes, their foods, the fit marks and the starter foods. Give a Serbian home Serbian staples (kiseli kupus, kajmak, pavlaka) instead of Magerquark and Hüttenkäse.
Language
Camera and small labels in English

Camera tabs 'Barcode', 'Label', 'Group', 'Meal'. She read 'Group' as a group of people and tried it for her friends. It is for products ('Ceo proizvod, jedna strana po fotografiji').
